name: Gilded Illusion: Isle's Echoes
source:
On Eldoria, only the captivating survive. Play as Elias, a fallen heir, in a cutthroat reality show full of alliances, betrayals, and mysteries. 

Will you win the golden cup, or discover what really happened to your family?

[From [url=https://saralcats.itch.io/gilded-illusion-isles-echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在艾尔多利亚，只有迷人的人才能够生存。在充满联盟、背叛和神秘的残酷真人秀中，扮演堕落的继承人埃利亚斯。

你会赢得金杯，还是发现你的家人到底发生了什么？

[来自[url=https://saralcats.itch.io/gilded-illusion-isles-echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
